LightningComponentBundle.description: Standardised Flow fault panel: user message, next steps, reference ID with copy button, expandable technical details, and Try again / Cancel buttons that drive flow navigation. Feed it the outputs of the FlowFaultHandlerCore subflow.

property.name: heading
property.label: Heading
property.description: Defaults to the FlowFaultHeading custom label.

property.name: technicalMessage
property.label: Technical Message
property.description: From FlowFaultHandlerCore.technicalMessage; shown behind an expander

property.name: adminGuidance
property.label: Admin Guidance
property.description: From FlowFaultHandlerCore.adminGuidance; shown inside the expander

property.name: isUserCorrectable
property.label: Is User Correctable
property.description: Switches the panel to warning styling

property.name: isLogged
property.label: Is Logged
property.description: When false, adds a notice asking the user to include the technical details

property.name: allowRetry
property.label: Allow Retry
property.description: Hide the Try again button when the parent flow cannot loop back

property.name: retryLabel
property.label: Retry Button Label
property.description: Defaults to the FlowFaultTryAgain custom label

property.name: cancelLabel
property.label: Cancel Button Label
property.description: Defaults to the FlowFaultCancel custom label

property.name: selectedAction
property.label: Selected Action
property.description: Retry or Cancel, set when the user clicks a button
